prompt:
The section sections/award-list-edges.liquid renders a list of awards from its blocks. Keep the schema block byte-for-byte, and change the rendering as described below. Inputs: - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each block is an object {"type": "award", "settings": {"name": string or null, "year": integer or null}}. New rules: 1. Valid awards. A block is a valid award only when its name, after stripping leading and trailing whitespace, is non-empty. Blocks with a null, empty or whitespace-only name are skipped entirely. The displayed name is the stripped name, HTML-escaped. 2. Empty list. If there are no valid awards (including an empty blocks array), the section outputs nothing at all: an empty string. 3. Item classes. Each rendered item is `
  • `. CLASSES is always "award-list__item". - The first rendered (valid) item additionally gets " award-list__item--first". - The last rendered (valid) item additionally gets " award-list__item--last". - A single rendered item gets both, in the order first then last: "award-list__item award-list__item--first award-list__item--last". - First and last refer to valid awards in block order, not to raw block positions. A skipped leading or trailing block must not prevent the first or last valid award from getting its class. 4. Latest label. Inside the first rendered item, before the name, output `Latest`. Do this only when there are at least 2 valid awards. A single award gets no label. 5. Item contents. After the optional label comes `NAME`. If year is not null, follow it with `YEAR`. This year behavior is unchanged from the current file. Existing rules to keep: - The heading is `

    HEADING

    ` (HTML-escaped). - The heading is output only when section.settings.heading is non-null and non-empty. It is not stripped. Output is a single line with no whitespace between tags: `
    ` + optional heading + `
      ` + items in block order + `
    `. There must be no leading or trailing whitespace or newlines. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/award-list-edges.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
